source.quote: We have a cross-license agreement with DriveTime Automotive Group, Inc. (together with its subsidiaries and affiliates, other than us, "DriveTime"), a related party of the Company, pursuant to which DriveTime has obtained limited licenses to some of our intellectual property

source.quote: Wholesale sales and revenues includes aggregate proceeds we receive on vehicles sold to DriveTime through competitive online auctions that are managed by an unrelated third party

relations.text: 金融債権を継続的に買い取る契約があり、2025年10月に最大60億ドルへ増額された
relations.text_en: Ally has a forward flow agreement to buy finance receivables, with its commitment raised to up to $6.0 billion in October 2025

source.label: カーバナ 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: On October 28, 2025, the Ally MPSA was amended to, among other things, increase the commitment by Ally to purchase up to $6.0 billion of principal balance of finance receivables between October 28, 2025, and October 27, 2026

relations.text: 在庫購入資金のフロアプラン融資をアライと結んでいた

source.quote: The Company previously entered into a floor plan facility with Ally to finance its vehicle inventory

relations.text: 輸送車両の購入資金として最大2億5000万ドルの融資契約を結んだ
relations.text_en: Carvana signed a loan agreement for up to $250 million to finance its transportation fleet equipment

source.label: カーバナ 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: the Company entered into a loan and security agreement (the "Loan Agreement") with Citizens Bank, N.A. ("Citizens Bank"), which provides for up to $250 million in aggregate principal amount of loans to finance certain equipment for its transportation fleet
